page.lede: Every piece in this reel is a Volume 1 style aimed at a different niche with a params file: new words, numbers, colours and facts, and no new animation code. Every frame and every sound is still generated live from code.

page.piecesIntro: Each piece is a Volume 1 style with new params. Hover a thumbnail to preview it; the play button jumps the reel to that piece. Real figures are sourced under each piece; invented ones say so.
page.rulesIntro: The same rules as Volume 1, measured again from this reel's own timeline when the page loads.

rules.title: Change something every two seconds
rules.text: Across the {pieces} pieces, the longest stretch without a new visual event is {maxGap}.

rules.title: Put a sound on every hit
rules.text: The reel carries {cues} sound cues in {duration}, one every {cueEvery}, each placed on the frame of the event it belongs to.

rules.title: Let the number ride the picture
rules.text: The tag rides the savings curve, the army count falls along the march, and each town lights up as the sound front reaches it.

rules.title: Compute it, don't type it
rules.text: Totals, winners, ratios, distances and dial angles are computed from the params, so a new number is a re-render, not a redraw.

rules.title: Get the facts right
rules.text: Real figures are sourced under each piece, and invented channels, products and cases are labelled as fictional.
